title: A beautiful and efficient app
body: Works great, looks great, and keeps you coming back. No fluff habit recording - nothing like it out there. No ads make it beautiful. Just got the annual pro version!
author: RitenV

title: Great but limited
body: The app is really practical and customizable for a free option, but you can only add 4 separate habits which is not very ideal.
author: Layan_ajl

title: App for Apple Watch
body: I really like the app, was hoping if there would be an Apple Watch version in the future?
author: mfaisalk

title: Reset button
body: Backup and restore option is handy! Wish there is a one button to reset and start all over again. Currently that feature is not available under settings
author: Sandanuwan
